title: Work Order 0417
author: Odessa Kiln, Kiln & Co. Salvage
pages: Client: the county (verbal). Site: Beaucatcher ridge, impact area. Scope: cut, load and remove all debris. Rate: cash, daily. Crew: D. Harrow, R.

Pruitt, T. Vance, M. Reyes.

Notes: Do not file the job with the state. Coils to the warehouse floor; lenses and crystal to the office safe. Teo is NOT to go near the inner chamber.

Rudy is NOT to sell anything without asking.

Added later, in pencil: The county never paid. Nobody from the county answers the phone. Dell says the hull is healing. I think he's right.
